achievements_intro: At Electrotech Automatisation Industrielle, we take pride in the strides we've made in the electrical panel automation industry. Each achievement represents our dedication to quality, innovation, and exceptional service. We’ve helped our clients achieve their goals, and we’re excited to share some of our proudest moments with you.
milestone_1_title: Over the years, we successfully completed over 10,000 projects and 25,000 panels.
milestone_1_desc: We’ve worked on a variety of projects, from small systems to large-scale installations. Our diverse experience ensures we can handle any challenge.
milestone_2_desc: We are proud to be trusted by some of the most respected companies in the industry, who count on us for reliable and high-quality solutions.
milestone_3_desc: We completed a large-scale project for a customer where we built all the control panels. This project showcased our ability to handle complex automation systems with precision and care.
milestone_4_desc: All our electrical panels are CSA certified, ensuring they meet the highest safety and quality standards recognized across the industry.
testimonial_1: "We couldn’t have asked for a better team to handle our electrical panel automation project. The service was prompt, professional, and delivered beyond our expectations."
testimonial_2: "The team at Electrotech Automatisation Industrielle delivered exceptional results. They understood our needs from the beginning and executed the project flawlessly."
glance_1: Over 25 years of experience in electrical panel automation.
glance_2: Successful projects completed in various industries.
glance_3: CSA certifications on all our panels.
glance_5: Safety standards upheld across all projects.
why_proud_title: Why We’re Proud of Our Achievements
why_proud_desc: Our achievements reflect our continuous pursuit of excellence. Every project we undertake is an opportunity for us to grow and enhance our expertise. We’re committed to delivering high-quality results and building lasting relationships with our clients.
work_with_us_desc: We’d love to help you with your electrical panel automation needs. Contact us today to discuss your project, and let us show you how we can achieve success together.
